messages:
incident-bot: realtime-p99 detector fired for /v1/chat.generate in region eu-central-1 - alert ALERT-9812. p99 jump detected at 12:03:45 UTC
jess (sre): paging oncall, looking at dashboards (graphs: p95/p99 by route, streaming stalls by session)
tomas (eng-oncall): oncall - what's the scope? single customer or broad?
jess (sre): initial telemetry: overall p95 from ~220ms -> 1.1s, p99 spiked to ~3.6s; streaming stalled frames increased x5; error rate stable at ~0.02%
amir (runtime): I see a surge in kernel fallback logs on model-shard-eu-02 around 2790012300 — kernels falling back to slower aten path due to a failed fused-attn probe after a recent micro-compile
jess (sre): any recent rollouts or infra churn?
amir (runtime): yes, a scheduled micro-compiler rollout that landed an optimized matmul path (opt-matmul-v3) onto 3 nodes in the shard pool at 2790012200. We have repros where opt-matmul falls back causing high single-thread latency
lina (support): got two tickets from customers in EU reporting streaming stalls and slow response chunks, they pasted traces with long gaps in the stream
tomas (eng-oncall): mitigation plan? Can we isolate the nodes and route traffic away?
amir (runtime): propose (A) mark those nodes as draining in control-plane, (B) enable fallback-routing to compiled-stable-v1, (C) temporarily lift batching threshold to reduce queueing latency
jess (sre): do it. Also increase observability sampling for the affected trace spans
amir (runtime): running commands:
```
redwoodctl node set-drain --nodes=model-shard-eu-02a,model-shard-eu-02b --drain-ttl=45s
redwoodctl routing override --route /v1/chat.generate --target compiled-stable-v1 --priority=high
```
ops-bot: routing override applied, traffic shifted away from model-shard-eu-02 to compiled-stable-v1
jess (sre): scaling up compiled-stable-v1 replicas to absorb burst
ops-bot: scaled deployment compiled-stable-v1 from 4 -> 9 replicas via autoscaler
lina (support): replied to affected customers: "We're investigating a short-term performance regression in EU; mitigation is underway. We'll update within 30 minutes."
amir (runtime): dropping micro-compiler rollout flag for opt-matmul-v3 on the three nodes; initiating recompile to previous kernel set
amir (runtime): command: `compilerctl rollback --patch opt-matmul-v3 --nodes model-shard-eu-02a,model-shard-eu-02b,model-shard-eu-02c`
jess (sre): p95/p99 graphs are trending back: p95 ~ 300ms, p99 ~ 820ms; streaming stall rate halving
tomas (eng-oncall): nice. Keep observation window 20m before we close paging. If p99 stays <1s for 15m okay to stand down
amir (runtime): will run local regression harness hitting compiled-stable-v1 and also run a KV cache consistency check - suspicious marker: prefix-cache miss rate spiked during regression
jess (sre): creating incident page and assigning roles (owner=jess, runtime-lead=amir, customer-comm=lina)
jess (sre): incident page: https://incident.redwood.ai/INC-9812
ops-bot: incident INC-9812 created with severity P1 and page to platform-oncall
lina (support): I'll send an interim update to the enterprise contacts with timelines and attach logs if they want them
amir (runtime): post-mitigation action items: (1) audit compiler rollout gating checks, (2) improved canary traffic shape to include heavy streaming traces, (3) add probe to detect kernel fallback rate >0.5%
jess (sre): also add a quick-run dashboard for p95/p99 by compiled-kernel-version so we can catch these earlier
tomas (eng-oncall): note for follow-up: consider automated rollback when fallback rate > threshold + p99 regression within 10m
ops-bot: monitoring alert cleared for ALERT-9812 (p99 back under threshold)
jess (sre): closing triage thread to watchlist; leaving incident page open for postmortem and long-tail mitigations
lina (support): customers updated: "Mitigation applied, performance stabilized. We'll follow up with a root cause update and postmortem."
amir (runtime): will validate rollback in staging and re-run the micro-compile on a non-stream-heavy canary set before reintroducing opt-matmul-v3
tomas (eng-oncall): thanks all. Keep the watch channel active for 20m, then we can downgrade severity if stable."
